subject: Re: NexaMed procurement sequencing — evidence windows & rollback checkpoints
messages:
From: Heather Liu <heather.liu@nexamed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nexamed.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NexaMed MAP & evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Irene — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to pull together a tight plan for the legal / procurement sequence so we can hit our July production date. High level asks from our side: 

- We need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to contract checkpoints (MSA, DPA, order form).
- Evidence windows for SOC2 + encryption guidance (security team wants delivery of SOC2 summary before signature).
- A rollback/contingency plan if acceptance testing slips past the planned cutover.

Can you/your team send a suggested sequencing (milestone dates + responsible owner) and confirm whether Redwood can accept a July 15th soft-signature (MSA) with final order form to follow after acceptance testing?

If it helps, I can loop in our legal (Mark Benson) and procurement ops — they're on cc.

Thanks,
Heather
Heather Liu
Senior Program Manager
NexaMed

--
Attachment: NexaMed_requirement_highlevel.csv (referenced, procurement list)

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Heather Liu <heather.liu@nexamed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaMed MAP & evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Heather — appreciate the clear asks. Draft plan below (high-level sequencing + owners). I picked conservative buffers around acceptance windows to give both teams time to resolve any evidence gaps. If you want, we can convert this to a shared Google Sheet and drive a daily stand for the week of July 6.

Proposed sequencing (draft MAP):
1) July 1 — Contract kickoff (MSA primary contacts): Redwood legal (Karthik) + NexaMed legal (Mark) — owner: legal teams
2) July 2–6 — Evidence exchange window: Redwood provides SOC2 summary + encryption notes; NexaMed confirms outstanding evidence requests — owner: Redwood security (Grace) / NexaMed procurement
3) July 7 — Evaluation acceptance smoke tests begin (1 week window) — owner: NexaMed engineering + Redwood onboarding engineer
4) July 14 — Soft-signature target for MSA (non-binding until order form executed) — owner: NexaMed procurement
5) July 15–21 — Order form finalization & pricing confirmation (DocuSign routing) — owner: commercial (Karthik)
6) July 22 — Production cutover contingent on acceptance pass; rollback decision gate at 24 hours post-cutover if critical issues appear — owner: joint runbook leads

Rollback/contingency highlights:
- If acceptance failures > 5 blocked tests on July 14, we pause order-form signature and trigger 72-hour remediation sprint.
- Redwood will provide a temporary throttle/fallback to hosted API and a read-only KV snapshot for NexaMed during remediation to prevent data loss.

Attachments we will send now:
- Redwood SOC2 summary (high-level) — attachment stub: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
- Initial MSA redline (commercial + security appendices) — attachment stub: MSA_redline_v3.docx

Questions for you: 
- Can NexaMed commit to review SOC2 summary by EOD July 3?
- Is a July 14 soft-signature acceptable as a milestone, or do you need earlier?

I can iterate once I hear from Mark on legal redlines.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

--
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (stub), MSA_redline_v3.docx (stub)

From: Mark Benson <mark.benson@nexamed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Heather Liu <heather.liu@nexamed.com>, procurement@nexamed.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaMed MAP & evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Irene, Heather — quick legal view. Thanks for pulling this together. A couple of constraints from our side: 

1) SOC2 summary is useful but procurement/legal need either the full SOC2 Type II or auditor attestation before we execute the DPA. A "summary" will not be sufficient to close the DPA clause for production handling of PHI.
2) We need to negotiate the indemnity carve-out around model outputs (explicit exclusion language) — I will circulate a redline to MSA that includes this ask.
3) Our procurement team cannot accept a soft-signature milestone that would obligate payment before we have a signed DPA attached. We can do a soft MSA signature for internal gating but we require DPA countersigned prior to order form execution.

Proposed small adjustments to the MAP: move DPA execution to July 14 (same day as MSA soft but countersigned), order form sign window to July 20–22. If Redwood can provide auditor attestation by July 6, that would let us keep the July 22 production target.

I'll send a redline with the indemnity language later today.

Regards,
Mark Benson
Sr. Counsel, NexaMed

--
Attachment: Mark_NexaMed_MSA_comments.docx (referenced)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Mark Benson <mark.benson@nexamed.com>, Heather Liu <heather.liu@nexamed.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaMed MAP & evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Mark/Heather — thanks for the clarity. Quick notes from commercial/legal at Redwood: 

- We can provide the SOC2 Type II auditor attestation by July 6; Grace on security is lining up the signed attestation with our auditor now.
- We are ok to target DPA countersign on July 14 alongside an MSA soft execution as long as the DPA contains a short interim clause that limits liability during the acceptance window (we want to avoid payment triggers until order form is final).
- For the indemnity carve-out: our standard stance is to limit model output indemnities and provide a mitigation pathway. I'm including a short proposed clause in the attached redline.

Action items assigned:
- Redwood: send SOC2 attestation by July 6 (Grace) — will attach to HubSpot deal record.
- NexaMed: confirm procurement team will run DocuSign routing July 15–22 and assign internal signature owner.
- Joint: daily 20-min stand July 6–10 to clear evidence gaps — proposed time 10:00am PT.

I'll upload a commercial-ready order form template to the DocuSign link once we confirm the DPA language.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal (Commercial), Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming next steps from NexaMed: 

- Procurement will attempt DocuSign routing on July 15; internal signature owner is Sarah Kim (procurement@nexamed.com).
- Legal confirms they will review Redwood indemnity excerpt and SOC2 attestation once received July 6. Mark to share his redline this afternoon.
- Agreed to daily 10:00am PT stand July 6–10 (Heather + Sarah + Mark + Irene + Karthik + Grace). I'll send calendar invites shortly.

If we get the auditor attestation by July 6 and the DPA countersigned by July 14, NexaMed will maintain the July 22 production cutover target. If acceptance testing reveals critical issues during July 7–14, we will trigger the remediation sprint and adjust order-form timing accordingly.

Thanks — sending calendar invites now.

Best,
